issue.title: kernel-drift: realign all rings to the immutable Grail Brainstem
issue.body:
## Constitutional blocker

RAPP/1 rev-10 §11.1 and Protocol Constitution Article 15 now define the Grail kernel as permanently immutable. The Canary Preprod control plane pins:

- repository: `kody-w/rapp-installer`
- ref: `refs/tags/brainstem-v0.6.16`
- commit: `5fbde1776a72715935c3d597a9ddfce28a04032b`
- blob: `3f7102ff508c813bb6494511fc32a421a633e418`
- SHA-256: `bd55a7f0bcf5efd3f7966ca39bb146da3c25fda9a0b1ce5ba587919d3c3775f4`
- grail_id: `grail:1a501dd7a01f05698abcf5f9bbe0273ebb9d09f5d6ec444aa71edccff947c8c7`

Current Canary, Nightly, Alpha, and Beta all carry Brainstem SHA-256 `4baa785b57f559367fa21d184c1d6900ac8a43977d3d70d7df88352660c80339`, so promotion and whole-train qualification correctly fail with `kernel-drift`. Grail itself must not be changed.

## Required migration

- inventory every behavior introduced after the v0.6.16 Grail kernel, especially authentication/state-survival behavior
- move each required behavior into agents, adapters, installers, configuration, frames, or external control-plane components
- restore `rapp_brainstem/brainstem.py` in Canary to the exact pinned bytes and prove feature parity externally
- promote the aligned payload through Nightly, Alpha, and Beta
- rerun whole-train qualification, authenticated soak, and Stage Preprod
- do not close until all four rings pass `verify-kernel` and no Grail repository byte was changed

A red autonomous gate is intentional until this migration is complete.

comment.body:
Resolved by the pristine production runway.

Aligned main commits:

- Nightly: `0b68d80c3ec9e0d869aa334bb05dd1c9fabace69`
- Alpha: `6d81fdab3814097ba42dd40bbd923bbc1d5ea32e`
- Beta: `b7f43591a728fe6b0d9f0bda46046817d4f6f098`

All four mains now carry immutable Brainstem SHA-256 `bd55a7f0bcf5efd3f7966ca39bb146da3c25fda9a0b1ce5ba587919d3c3775f4`. Nightly/Alpha/Beta have zero shared differences from production; Canary has exactly one shared delta, `tests/test_installer.sh`. Main preflight, Pages, and the autonomous whole-train matrix are green.

Preserved work:
- Canary `feature/post-grail-changes`
- Nightly/Alpha/Beta `archive/pre-pristine-20260830`

No Grail repository byte was changed. Future behavior is reintroduced one external layer at a time under RAPP CI/CD and RAPP Deploy.

issue.body:

- `H`: match
- `Hb`: match
- `canonical`: mismatch
- `embedded_matches_public_reference`: false

The current reference `rapp.py` SHA-256 is `df9b5cc821db2a10691c6653507957b0bf23ccfa11b8c84c756974a257290057`; `SPEC.md` SHA-256 is `78f9cae4cbed02c7b5cd2a648350ccb4ffeacebb49fcbbe34ac6c80a4e507cf0`.
